description.description: How your stone godform looks, in your words: the figure, the pose, what it holds. Kept character for character when the verdict is ok. Newlines and tabs allowed; other control characters refused.

pose.description: A classical pose, or custom (then the description says the pose and may not be empty).

stone.description: A preset id (white_marble, black_onyx, granite, sandstone, jade, bronze, gold_leaf) or your own words (one line, at least one letter; judged by the same pass).
